The Bachelor of Commerce (Honours) in Business Management combines industry demands with rigorous academic preparation, creating a solid foundation for success in various business-related fields. Core subjects include Strategic

Management, Management Accounting, Entrepreneurship and Innovation, Human Resources Management, Organizational Design, Leadership Skills, Research for Business, Special Topics in CR, Business Trends, Corporate

Strategy, and more.

Thinking.
69i5:
International Business University's Bachelor of Commerce (Honours) in International Management and Technology degree responds to the needs of Canadian and international employers for graduates who combine business knowledge, soft skills and technical skills and who are able to transition seamlessly into the workplace

Equipped with business knowledge together with the most relevant technologies, students will develop the knowledge, skills, attitudes and behaviours that employers are looking for today. Graduates will be able to apply both their knowledge and interpersonal skills in integrated projects alongside a capstone course incorporated into the curriculum.

IBU's BComm programs have been accredited by National Committee for Management Association (NCMA) in Canada. Students graduating from these programs will meet the academic requirements equivalent to the Chartered Management Program (CMP) framework. The CMP can lead to the Certified in Management (C.I.M.®) and Chartered Manager (C.Mgr.®) professional designations.

The Master of Science in Applied AI – Data Engineering Specialization is a postgraduate program designed to provide students with advanced expertise in artificial intelligence, with a strong emphasis on data engineering and scalable data systems. The program prepares graduates to design, develop, and manage data infrastructures that power modern AI-driven applications across a wide range of industries.

Students gain in-depth knowledge in areas such as big data technologies, data pipelines, cloud computing, database systems, and machine learning. The curriculum focuses on integrating AI models with efficient data processing frameworks, enabling students to work with large, complex datasets and deliver data-driven solutions.

The program combines theoretical foundations with practical, hands-on experience through projects and applied learning, allowing students to build and optimize data architectures and implement AI solutions in real-world contexts. It also addresses important considerations such as data governance, ethics, and security in AI systems.

The course culminates in a research project or thesis, where students can specialize in a chosen area within applied AI and data engineering. Graduates are well-prepared for roles such as data engineer, machine learning engineer, AI specialist, and data architect, as well as for further academic research or doctoral study.
96o8:
The Master of Science in Applied AI – Industrial Innovation Specialization is a postgraduate program designed to equip students with advanced knowledge and practical skills in applying artificial intelligence to modern industrial and business environments. The course focuses on how AI technologies can drive innovation, optimize processes, and improve efficiency across sectors such as manufacturing, logistics, and smart industries.

Students explore key areas including machine learning, automation, intelligent systems, data analytics, and digital transformation strategies. The program emphasizes the integration of AI into industrial operations, enabling students to design and implement solutions that enhance productivity, quality control, and decision-making.

Through a combination of theoretical study and hands-on projects, students gain experience in applying AI tools to real-world challenges, such as predictive maintenance, process optimization, and smart system development. The curriculum also addresses important topics such as innovation management, ethics, and the impact of AI on industry and society.

The program culminates in a research project or thesis, allowing students to specialize in an area of interest within applied AI and industrial innovation. Graduates are well-prepared for careers in AI development, industrial automation, technology consulting, and innovation management, as well as for further academic research.
